fact: ASIN's July 2026 legal note treats Benin's interoperability framework as in place, setting registration, technical and contractual conditions for connecting to the Xroad-BJ exchange platform, with the Comité national d'interopérabilité supervising; the note's date is the published date, 2026-07-28, no event date being given.

Benin's Cadre d'interopérabilité, published by ASIN, is instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020 and sets four levels (juridical, organisational, semantic, technical) and five common infrastructure components; the document carries no publication date, so 2020-03-18 is the instituting decree's date.

ASIN held a sectoral consultation workshop in Cotonou on the draft Politique d'architecture des systèmes d'information de l'État (PASI), which sets organising principles, technical rules and standards to make public information systems interoperable, before final versions go to the Ministry of Digital Affairs.
